summary: Tested Momentum persistent AI agent (iteration 4): backend agent chat with tool-calling, note reflection endpoint, and floating agent UI persistence. 13/13 backend tests passed. All frontend flows (FAB visibility on all routes, panel persistence across navigation & reload, create_task, update_task, add_note, break_down_goal, note reflection, grounded context) verified working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: NotesPage save-reflection-button re-calls /api/agent/reflect-note with save=True — this triggers a SECOND LLM call to re-generate the reflection instead of persisting the already-shown text. Wastes tokens and can produce a different reflection from what the user just read. Recommend a separate persist-only endpoint OR pass the already-generated reflection text in the save call.

server.py line ~910: sorted({...} - {""}) uses set comprehension of dict-value lookups. Works, but the intent (unique invalidation targets) would be clearer as sorted(set(...) - {""}). Minor readability.
Agent create_task tool ignores due_date sanitization — accepts any string. Not exploited but no format validation.

AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT lists tool schemas but the LLM must return JSON manually. Real tool-calling API (function_call) would be more robust than JSON-in-text parsing. Currently works for claude-sonnet-4-6 but is fragile if model drifts.
test_credentials: Auto-auth via GET /api/auth/session — no login. Owner user: owner@momentum.app
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up: TEST_/UITEST_ prefixed tasks, notes, goals
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0. All agent tool calls confirmed via chip data-testids (agent-action-{tool}-ok). Frontend persistence works: FloatingAgent is mounted outside Routes in App.js and messages hydrate from GET /api/agent/history on mount.
